method: Visual review of all 67 originals in the full contact sheet, plus enlarged comparisons of the main wordmark and banner layouts. Grouped by geometry and meaningful artwork, ignoring minor color, crop, scale, glow, localization and replacement-wording differences.

groups.selection_reason: Clean 3886x1508 white original without the tiny TM mark; retains the standard Roman II, skull and wings layout.
